text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains and losses are not enough reason to react to short-term price moves; keep decisions tied to long-term goals and risk.","Selling Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but my average cost is not a reason by itself to sell or hold; assess each position on its merits.","Avoid letting losses feel twice as powerful as gains: review the whole portfolio, diversify, and make deliberate changes rather than trading from emotion."]}
